About the job

Position Title: TikTok Shop Affiliate Specialist

Department: Marketing & Creator Operations

Reports To: Director of Content and Community

Location: Remote — US & LATAM

Job Type: Full-Time




Company Overview

Our client a fast-growing US-Based pet brand selling innovative tools that have quickly become essentials in millions of homes.

Their products reach customers through their direct-to-consumer store and major retailers. Creator-led commerce—especially on TikTok Shop—is one of their fastest-growing acquisition channels.




Position Summary

We are seeking an organized, proactive, and creator-obsessed TikTok Shop Affiliate Specialist to support the daily operations and scaling of our creator program.

In this hands-on role, your primary mission is to ensure our affiliate pipeline never stalls. You will drive daily outreach, manage creator sample fulfillment, coordinate automated communications, moderate our creator community, and analyze short-form content patterns that generate revenue. Working directly with our Director of Content and Community, you will turn high-level campaign plans into consistent operational action that directly impacts month-over-month affiliate GMV.




Key Responsibilities

1. TikTok Shop & Affiliate Operations

Support the day-to-day execution and operational health of the client's TikTok Shop affiliate program.
Build, launch, and optimize creator outreach campaigns and automated follow-up sequences using Cruva.
Review incoming sample requests, evaluating creators based on audience fit, content quality, and sales potential.
Coordinate time-sensitive sample fulfillment workflows directly with our warehouse logistics team.
Monitor TikTok Shop account health, handle documentation, manage support tickets, and resolve operational roadblocks quickly.
Track program risks, performance gaps, and activation metrics, reporting insights directly to the Affiliate Marketing Manager.

2. Campaign Execution & Content Analysis

Help execute affiliate campaigns, creator contests, seasonal challenges, and performance incentives.
Clear campaign details, deadlines, and deliverables to creators; track participation and follow up to drive posting volume.
Analyze creator content to identify why specific videos win or underperform (evaluating hooks, lighting, product demonstrations, pacing, and calls-to-action).
Translate winning content patterns into actionable creator briefs and share performance insights with internal teams.
Develop and test new campaign angles to reactivate dormant creators and underutilized communication channels.

3. Community Management & Engagement

Act as the frontline voice for the brand across TikTok Shop Affiliate Center Messages and our Creator Discord.
Foster an active, supportive creator community by posting announcements, content inspiration, challenge updates, and actionable tips.
Answer creator inquiries promptly, ensuring affiliates feel supported rather than treated as transactional partners.
Utilize AI and automation tools to streamline recurring reminders, updates, and creator follow-ups.

4. Ambassador, UGC & Social Strategy Support

Support the reactivation and ongoing management of our ambassador program via Upfluence.
Source UGC creators for scripted ad content, retail push campaigns, and new product launch initiatives.
Support the broader organic social strategy by scheduling approved short-form content in Later.
Edit raw UGC clips into platform-native, high-converting social posts across TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube.




Required Qualifications & Experience

Experience: Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience managing or supporting a TikTok Shop affiliate program for a CPG/consumer brand (outside of the fashion category).
Platform Knowledge: Proficiency with TikTok Shop Affiliate Center, short-form social platforms, and creator management software. Direct experience with Cruva, Upfluence, Discord, and Later is strongly preferred.
Content Literacy: Strong instincts for short-form video mechanics—you know what makes a compelling hook, a smooth product demo, and a converting call-to-action.
Technical Skills: Experience utilizing AI tools and workflows to automate repetitive creator communication and task management. Basic short-form video editing skills.
Soft Skills: Exceptional organizational skills, high attention to detail, proactive problem-solving, and strong written communication skills tailored for creator relationships.




Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Outreach & Activation: Consistency of creator outreach and speed of sample request processing.
Creator Participation: Increase in creator posting volume and participation rate in active campaigns.
Community Engagement: Response time and engagement levels within Discord and Affiliate Center messages.
Revenue Impact: Measurable contribution to overall month-over-month TikTok Shop affiliate GMV growth.




What We Offer

Work Environment: 100% Fully Remote work structure (US-based).
Time Off: Paid Time Off (PTO) package plus quarterly flex days to recharge.
Career Growth: Professional development support and opportunities to grow within a high-growth e-commerce brand.

description:
About the job

Rockstar is recruiting for a marketplace management firm that handles e-commerce operations for brands across major retail channels. They specialize in catalog management, content, retail operations, and advertising on platforms like Amazon, Walmart, and Target Plus. Their AI Agentic Commerce practice builds proprietary tooling for optimized performance.


About the Company



The company manages the marketplace business for brands that can't afford to get it wrong. They handle catalog, content, retail operations, and advertising across Amazon (Seller Central and Vendor Central), Walmart Marketplace, Target Plus, and other emerging channels, and they run an AI Agentic Commerce practice building their own tooling for this work.

Their clients span consumer packaged goods, cosmetics, skincare, apparel, footwear, and handbags. They hire them to operate their channel, not to advise from a distance.


The Role



Advertising Analysts run the accounts. This is the seat where the work actually happens.

Analysts own the day-to-day management of advertising for a set of client brands across Amazon, Walmart Marketplace, and Target Plus — building campaigns, managing bids and budgets, adjusting targeting, watching pacing, and finding the changes that move performance. Their manager sets the strategy and the media plan; they make it real in the platform, and they are the first person to know when something isn't working.

This is an individual contributor role, but it isn't a heads-down one. Analysts work directly with the Strategy & Implementation Team on retail readiness — inventory, catalog, promotions, detail page quality — and with the Design Team on creative for Sponsored Brands, video, and display. Advertising in these channels doesn't perform in isolation, and analysts who understand that make better recommendations than analysts who only look at ad reports.

Analysts also do a meaningful amount of thinking, not just executing. They run account audits, dig into search term and placement data to find waste and opportunity, build the analysis behind quarterly and annual business reviews, and prepare the decks their manager presents to client leadership. Where they see a better answer than the plan calls for, the company wants to hear it.

The company expects analysts to use AI in their work. The team uses AI for report analysis, bulk file preparation, keyword and search term work, audit drafting, and internal tooling. They don't need to be an engineer, but they should be comfortable working with AI tools and interested in using them to get through the mechanical parts of the job faster so they can spend more time on the parts that require judgment.

This role is a path to account and strategy ownership. The analysts who do it well are the people the company promotes.


What You'll Own


Campaign management and optimization: Build, launch, and manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Brands Video, Sponsored Display, and Amazon DSP campaigns, plus their Walmart Connect and Target Roundel equivalents. Manage bids, budgets, negatives, placement modifiers, and dayparting against agreed targets. Keep pacing on plan and flag risk before it becomes a shortfall.
Keyword, targeting, and audience work: Research and build keyword and product targeting sets, mine search term reports for new opportunity and wasted spend, and maintain clean negative structures. Support audience building and testing in DSP.
Analysis: Pull and interrogate the data yourself — search term, placement, product-level, and business reports — and turn it into a recommendation rather than a summary. Understand why a number moved, not just that it did.
Account audits: Perform structured audits on new and existing accounts: campaign architecture, targeting overlap, budget allocation, wasted spend, missed placements, and gaps between what the account is doing and what the strategy calls for. Write up findings clearly enough that someone else can act on them.
Client reporting and business reviews: Build the reporting that keeps clients informed, and prepare the analysis and decks for quarterly and annual business reviews. Your work goes in front of client leadership, so it needs to be accurate, clear, and defensible.
AI-assisted workflows: Use AI tools to speed up analysis, bulk file work, keyword processing, and documentation. Contribute to improving how the team works rather than just following the process you were handed.
Collaboration: Partner with the Strategy & Implementation Team on retail readiness and the Design Team on creative. Raise the constraints — inventory, catalog, pricing, page quality — that advertising can't fix on its own.

What You Bring



Required

2+ years hands-on experience building, managing, and optimizing Amazon advertising campaigns
Amazon Ads certification in Sponsored Ads and Amazon DSP (both required; verified)
Experience with Amazon DSP campaign management, not just Sponsored Ads
Genuinely analytical: comfortable in large data sets, can build your own analysis in Excel or Sheets, and check your own math
Intellectual curiosity: want to know why something happened, and keep pulling the thread after the immediate question is answered
Strong written and verbal communication: can explain a performance change in plain language and write findings a client can read
Proficiency working with AI tools and AI-assisted workflows
Detail discipline: bulk uploads, naming conventions, and negatives done right the first time


Preferred

Walmart Sponsored Ads and Walmart DSP certification
Meta and TikTok ads experience, with certifications
Target Roundel experience
SQL, Looker Studio / Google Data Studio, or Amazon Marketing Cloud exposure
Agency or multi-brand experience across categories
Advanced Excel; Python or scripting a plus
Familiarity with retail fundamentals: Buy Box, inventory health, catalog integrity, promotions, subscriptions

Who Does Well Here



The work is cyclical and the peaks are demanding — Q4 and Prime Day compress a quarter of decisions into a few weeks. The analysts who do well here treat a bad week as something to diagnose rather than defend, and would rather find the problem themselves than be told about it.

The company also looks for ownership (escalate early and don't lose things), intellectual honesty (would rather be corrected than confidently wrong), care about accuracy, and a habit of fixing a manual process the third time you run it.


What Success Looks Like


30 days: Managing daily optimizations on your accounts with light supervision, and you know each brand's structure, targets, and constraints.
90 days: Running your accounts independently, delivering audits and reporting your manager doesn't have to rewrite, and surfacing recommendations rather than waiting for direction.
12 months: Your accounts show measurable improvement you can explain, you're trusted in front of clients, and you've improved at least one thing about how the team works.

How to Stand Out



Come ready to walk through one account you improved — what you found, what you changed, and how you knew it worked.

This empowers our customers to identify risk sooner, spot opportunities faster and recalibrate strategy with confidence – whether planning days, weeks, months or decades ahead.

Wood Mackenzie

Intelligence Connected

About the job

Sobre Covalto

En Covalto estamos reinventando los servicios financieros para las PyMEs en Latinoamérica y más allá. A través de nuestras soluciones especializadas de intermediación financiera, ayudamos a las empresas a crecer, proporcionándoles el capital y las herramientas financieras que necesitan para desarrollarse y competir con éxito en el mercado norteamericano.

No buscamos simplemente empleados; buscamos Cóvalticos: personas innovadoras, disruptivas y con espíritu constructor, que se desenvuelvan con éxito en entornos Fintech dinámicos y de ritmo acelerado.




Tu misión

Como Growth & Sales Account Executive, tu misión será contribuir a la continuidad operativa y al crecimiento exponencial de Covalto.

Serás responsable de gestionar el ciclo completo de ventas de nuestras soluciones de intermediación financiera, enfocándote exclusivamente en PyMEs con operaciones en Norteamérica. Además, participarás activamente en el diseño y automatización de procesos para construir un motor comercial escalable, eficiente y preparado para el crecimiento futuro.




¿Qué harás? — Principales responsabilidades

Ser responsable del pipeline de ventas en EE. UU.

Gestionar de principio a fin el ciclo comercial de manera remota, desde la prospección y presentación de la solución hasta la negociación y cierre de operaciones de financiamiento con propietarios de empresas ubicadas en Norteamérica.

Diseñar y automatizar procesos

Colaborar en el diseño, implementación y automatización de sistemas y flujos de trabajo comerciales, incluyendo CRM, lead scoring, herramientas de prospección y outreach, con el objetivo de escalar las operaciones.

Entender las necesidades financieras de las PyMEs

Comprender las necesidades financieras de las PyMEs norteamericanas y posicionar las soluciones de intermediación financiera de Covalto como una herramienta estratégica para impulsar su crecimiento.

Colaboración entre áreas

Trabajar de manera cercana con los equipos de Riesgo, Producto y Operaciones para optimizar la experiencia del cliente durante todo el proceso, desde el onboarding hasta la obtención del financiamiento.




¿Qué buscamos?

Inglés avanzado — Requisito indispensable

Dominas el inglés de manera oral y escrita y tienes capacidad para negociar en inglés a nivel nativo o C1/C2. Comprendes el lenguaje corporativo estadounidense, sus expresiones habituales y las normas de etiqueta empresarial.

Conocimiento de la cultura empresarial norteamericana

Tienes un conocimiento profundo de la cultura de negocios de Norteamérica y comprendes cómo piensan, toman decisiones y hacen negocios los propietarios de PyMEs estadounidenses.

Experiencia en Fintech o Ventas

Cuentas con 3+ años de experiencia en ventas B2B, intermediación financiera, financiamiento transfronterizo o entornos SaaS de alto crecimiento.

Mentalidad de automatización

No te limitas a seguir un proceso: buscas constantemente cómo mejorarlo. La experiencia con personalización de CRM, Zapier o herramientas de automatización y gestión de ventas será altamente valorada.




Ubicación

Puedes estar ubicado/a en México, USA, Panana o Colombia.

Esquema de comisiones atractivo y transparente, además de un salario base altamente competitivo.
100% de trabajo remoto, con la posibilidad de generar impacto a nivel regional.
La oportunidad de construir y desarrollar una nueva vertical de negocio dentro de una Fintech líder.
Una cultura dinámica y orientada al alto desempeño, rodeado/a de talento de primer nivel y grandes Cóvalticos.

Pipeline Organization: Maintain detailed records of prospective accounts, contact details, and outreach activity in Airtable or a similar CRM.

Industry & Creative Experience: Background generating leads for visual media, agency services, or creative production businesses.

This is the dream role for a demand generation expert who loves setting up campaigns and uncovering high-value leads without the pressure of closing deals! title: Marketing and Lead Generation Manager
description:
About the job

Marketing & Lead Generation Manager




About the Role




Peterson Spring is looking for a results-driven Marketing & Lead Generation Manager to build and execute a modern B2B marketing strategy focused on generating qualified sales opportunities and supporting new business growth.




This position will work closely with the sales and business development teams to identify target customers, build awareness of Peterson Spring’s capabilities, generate qualified leads, and turn marketing activity into measurable sales opportunities.




The ideal candidate is not simply a social media manager. We are looking for someone who understands B2B manufacturing marketing, digital lead generation, content creation, targeted account marketing, and sales enablement and can take ownership of the process from strategy through execution.




Key Responsibilities




Lead Generation & Demand Generation




- Develop and execute strategies to generate qualified B2B sales leads.

- Build targeted prospect lists based on Peterson Spring’s ideal customer profile and target industries.

- Develop campaigns targeting specific companies, industries, and decision-makers.

- Utilize LinkedIn, email marketing, digital advertising, SEO, content marketing, and other channels to generate new opportunities.

- Develop and manage lead-generation campaigns in coordination with the sales team.

- Track leads from initial engagement through qualification and handoff to sales.

- Continuously test and improve campaigns based on performance.




Targeted Account Marketing




- Develop targeted marketing campaigns for high-value prospective customers.

- Research target companies, industries, products, and decision-makers.

- Create personalized marketing content and campaigns designed to get Peterson Spring in front of purchasing, engineering, supply chain, and other key decision-makers.

- Support account-based marketing initiatives for strategic prospects.

- Work directly with Business Development to identify priority accounts and create campaigns around them.




Content & Social Media




- Manage Peterson Spring’s LinkedIn and other relevant social media platforms.

- Create professional, engaging content that showcases Peterson Spring’s manufacturing capabilities, facilities, equipment, quality systems, products, and employees.

- Develop content that positions Peterson Spring as a capable supplier to Automotive, Aerospace & Defense, Industrial, and other target markets.

- Create case studies, customer success stories, brochures, sales presentations, email campaigns, and other sales-support materials.

- Coordinate photography, video, graphics, and other marketing assets.

- Maintain a consistent and professional brand presence across all channels.




Website & Digital Marketing




- Manage and continuously improve website content with a focus on generating sales inquiries.

- Develop landing pages and digital campaigns for targeted industries and products.

- Improve SEO and organic search visibility.

- Monitor website traffic, engagement, conversions, and lead sources.

- Identify opportunities to improve Peterson Spring's digital presence and online visibility.




Sales Support




- Work closely with Business Development and Account Managers to support active sales campaigns.

- Provide sales teams with prospect information, marketing materials, target-account research, and campaign results.

- Help develop presentations, brochures, capability documents, email campaigns, and other sales tools.

- Maintain visibility into marketing-generated leads and opportunities.

- Help establish a measurable connection between marketing activity and revenue.




Analytics & Reporting




- Establish measurable KPIs for marketing and lead-generation activities.

- Track leads, website traffic, campaign performance, engagement, conversion rates, and marketing-generated opportunities.

- Provide regular reporting to leadership.

- Identify what is working, what isn't, and make recommendations for improvement.

- Manage marketing budgets and maximize return on marketing spend.




Required Qualifications




- 3–7 years of marketing experience, preferably in B2B, manufacturing, industrial, automotive, aerospace, defense, or another technical industry.

- Demonstrated experience generating B2B leads and sales opportunities.

- Strong understanding of LinkedIn marketing and B2B social media.

- Experience with targeted account marketing / account-based marketing (ABM).

- Experience developing and executing digital marketing campaigns.

- Strong content creation and copywriting skills.

- Experience with email marketing and lead-nurturing campaigns.

- Understanding of SEO, website analytics, and digital advertising.

- Strong research skills and the ability to identify target companies and decision-makers.

- Experience working with a CRM and marketing automation platform.

- Strong communication and project-management skills.

- Ability to work independently and take ownership of projects from strategy through execution.

- Strong analytical mindset with the ability to use data to improve marketing performance.




Preferred Qualifications




- Experience marketing for a manufacturing or industrial company.

- Experience marketing to OEMs, Tier 1s, Tier 2s, distributors, or other B2B customers.

- Experience with HubSpot or similar CRM/marketing automation platforms.

- Experience with LinkedIn Campaign Manager and LinkedIn advertising.

- Experience with Google Analytics, Google Ads, SEO tools, or similar platforms.

- Experience creating marketing materials using Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar tools.

- Experience developing ABM campaigns.

- Familiarity with the Automotive or Aerospace & Defense industries.

- Experience supporting trade shows and industry events.

- Bilingual English/Spanish is a plus.




What Success Looks Like




The successful candidate will be measured by business results, not simply social media activity.




Key measures of success will include:




- Number of qualified leads generated.

- Number of sales opportunities generated.

- Marketing-generated revenue.

- Target accounts engaged.

- Website lead conversions.

- Email campaign performance.

- LinkedIn engagement and prospect growth.

- Growth in Peterson Spring's digital presence.

- Cost per qualified lead.

- Return on marketing investment.

- Sales team's utilization of marketing-generated leads and materials.




Ideal Candidate




We are looking for someone who is:




- Results-driven

- Highly organized and self-motivated

- Comfortable working independently

- Creative but also analytical

- Strong at researching and identifying opportunities

- Comfortable working directly with sales leadership

- Able to turn ideas into executed campaigns

- Comfortable working in a technical B2B environment

- Focused on generating measurable business results rather than vanity metrics




This is an opportunity for someone who wants to build a marketing and lead-generation function, not simply maintain an existing marketing program.




The ideal candidate will have the creativity to build the strategy, the technical knowledge to execute it, and the business mindset to connect marketing activity directly to new customer growth and revenue.

title: GTM Strategy Analyst
skills: Estrategia de crecimiento y asignación de recursos: definir, junto al liderazgo del negocio, la estrategia de adquisición de la compañía — qué canales (Outbound, Inbound, Brokers, Digital), qué segmentos (SMB/Mid/Corp) y qué economics justifican cada inversión

Owner analítico del funnel completo: NQL→SQL→Enrolamiento→Aprobación→Activación→Retención. Diagnosticar dónde se pierde valor, cuantificar el tamaño de cada oportunidad y mantener un Control Tower con CAC, payback, LTV y Gross Profit por canal, levantando alertas cuando algo se desvía de la tesis

Resolución de problemas estratégicos (tu día a día estilo consultoría): estructurar problemas ambiguos en análisis accionables — descomponer una caída de ventas en tasa × ticket × volumen, diagnosticar un funnel SDR, dimensionar un canal nuevo con un business case
Pricing & elegibilidad (con Riesgo): modelar bandas de precio/score-cut y diseñar/leer experimentos A/B que equilibren aprobación y margen
Research de cliente: entrevistas, jobs-to-be-done e insights de mercado que se traducen en ofertas, mensajes y apuestas de segmento

De la recomendación a la ejecución: bajar la estrategia a instrumentos operables — playbooks de Outbound, lead scoring, territories, listas activables (AI/enrichment), briefs de Digital — y coordinar handoffs con SDR/AE, Marketing y Growth
Cadencia operativa: preparar y facilitar WBR/MBR. No reportas métricas: cuentas la historia del negocio, propones la decisión y das seguimiento a los compromisos

Experimentación y gobierno de datos: priorizar hipótesis, diseñar tests, instrumentar tracking, productizar ganadores (playbook + métricas); definir eventos, taxonomías y QA de tracking con Analytics/Eng
Pensamiento estructurado: descompones problemas ambiguos en árboles de hipótesis, priorizas el análisis que mueve la decisión y comunicas con claridad ejecutiva (escrita y verbal)
Estratega operador(a): la recomendación no te basta; bajas la idea a dashboard, playbook y piloto en días, no semanas
Data chops: SQL intermedio-avanzado, manejo de BigQuery/Looker o equivalentes; familiaridad con causalidad/experimentos y métricas de funnel
AI driven: experto en Claude/Chat GPT/Gemini/otros, con casos de uso claros y con impacto
Track record de impacto en KPIs: has movido números concretos — enrolamientos, aprobación, activación, churn — y puedes contar el cómo, no solo el cuánto
Obsesión por el cliente: research continuo, entrevistas, jobs-to-be-done, y capacidad de transformar insights en ofertas y mensajes accionables
Influencia cross-functional: te mueves con Revenue, Growth, Riesgo, Producto y Finanzas con la misma comodidad, sin autoridad formal
Owner mindset: foco en impacto económico (CAC, payback, margen, LTV), no en entregables
2+ años en consultoría estratégica o roles GTM/Strategy/Growth/RevOps analíticos, ideal con foco en adquisición B2B (fintech, SaaS, pagos o lending es plus)
Experiencia probada gestionando funnel completo y mejorando KPIs (enrolamientos, aprobación, activación, churn)
SQL (intermedio a avanzado) y Excel/Sheets avanzado
La posición es para CDMX. Si actualmente estás en Chile pero tienes disponibilidad para mudarte a Ciudad de México, esta oportunidad puede ser para ti.

title: VFX & Generative AI Artist
description:
About the job

Buscamos un/a Artista de VFX e IA Generativa para integrarse al equipo interno de CAPONETO. Será un perfil práctico, creativo y resolutivo, capaz de editar contenido audiovisual, realizar composiciones y efectos visuales de complejidad media, corregir color e incorporar herramientas de inteligencia artificial a los procesos de creación y postproducción.




No buscamos necesariamente un especialista senior en efectos visuales, sino una persona versátil, con buen ojo, criterio audiovisual y curiosidad tecnológica, que pueda ejecutar piezas con autonomía y encontrar soluciones eficientes para distintos tipos de proyectos.




Responsabilidades

•⁠ ⁠Editar y terminar piezas audiovisuales para contenido digital, branded content, campañas, presentaciones, cine y televisión.

•⁠ ⁠Realizar compositing, limpieza de imagen, reemplazo de pantallas, integración de fondos, rotoscopia, tracking, chroma key y otros efectos visuales.

•⁠ ⁠Crear, modificar y extender imágenes y videos mediante herramientas de IA generativa.

•⁠ ⁠Desarrollar pruebas visuales, concept videos, animatics, previos y propuestas de estilo.

•⁠ ⁠Integrar material generado con IA dentro de piezas filmadas o editadas de manera tradicional.

•⁠ ⁠Mantener la continuidad visual de personajes, espacios, iluminación, movimiento y estilo en las imágenes generadas.

•⁠ ⁠Realizar corrección de color y looks básicos para unificar y terminar las piezas.

•⁠ ⁠Adaptar contenidos a diferentes duraciones, formatos y relaciones de aspecto.

•⁠ ⁠Preparar versiones y archivos finales conforme a las especificaciones de cada proyecto.

•⁠ ⁠Trabajar en coordinación con productores, directores, editores, diseñadores y el área de postproducción.

•⁠ ⁠Recibir notas creativas y técnicas, interpretarlas y ejecutar los ajustes correspondientes.

•⁠ ⁠Investigar nuevas herramientas y proponer formas concretas de incorporarlas a los procesos de CAPONETO.

•⁠ ⁠Organizar correctamente proyectos, archivos, versiones y materiales de trabajo.




Conocimientos técnicos

•⁠ ⁠Manejo sólido de Adobe Premiere Pro.

•⁠ ⁠Conocimientos intermedios de After Effects para compositing, tracking, rotoscopia, keying y motion graphics.

•⁠ ⁠Manejo de DaVinci Resolve para corrección de color y terminación.

•⁠ ⁠Experiencia con herramientas de generación y edición de video e imagen mediante inteligencia artificial.

•⁠ ⁠Capacidad para trabajar con prompts, imágenes de referencia, image-to-video, video-to-video, inpainting, outpainting y extensión generativa.

•⁠ ⁠Conocimiento de formatos, códecs, resoluciones, frame rates y espacios de color.

•⁠ ⁠Nociones de flujos de proxies, conformado, exportación y entrega.

•⁠ ⁠Deseable: conocimientos de Photoshop, Illustrator, Blender, Cinema 4D, Nuke o herramientas similares.




Perfil

•⁠ ⁠Experiencia comprobable en edición, postproducción, VFX o creación de contenido audiovisual.

•⁠ ⁠Reel o portafolio que muestre trabajos de edición, compositing, color y/o contenido generado con IA.

•⁠ ⁠Buen ojo para la composición, el ritmo, la iluminación, el color y la integración de imágenes.

•⁠ ⁠Interés genuino por experimentar con nuevas herramientas y procesos.

•⁠ ⁠Capacidad para resolver problemas técnicos y visuales con los recursos disponibles.

•⁠ ⁠Persona organizada, autónoma, detallista y responsable.

•⁠ ⁠Capacidad para trabajar en varios proyectos y responder a tiempos de entrega ajustados.

•⁠ ⁠Buena disposición para recibir feedback y trabajar en equipo.

•⁠ ⁠Español fluido e inglés suficiente para utilizar herramientas, investigar procesos y comprender documentación técnica.




Buscamos a alguien que combine sensibilidad audiovisual con habilidad técnica; que disfrute editar, probar, componer y resolver. Alguien que entienda la IA como una herramienta más dentro del proceso creativo y que pueda convertir una idea o referencia en una pieza terminada, coherente y lista para entregar.

description:
About the job

About The Role And Team

Working at Uber means solving hard problems in a high-stakes, fast-moving environment. As a CRM Marketing Associate, you will join the Global CRM team to bridge digital and real worlds, powering movement by showing millions of consumers the tangible impact of our products. You will lead the strategy and execution of acquisition campaigns across owned digital channels at a global scale.

This role is not about polished marketing; it's about navigating the messiness of global expansion and program scaling. You will need a "go-get-it" attitude and a mindset built for ownership and adaptability as you move fast to respond to the needs of our growing membership base. If you are energized by the challenge of driving experimentation and reporting results under high-pressure conditions, this is where you'll grow.

What You'll Do


Develop and execute global end-to-end CRM strategies focused on acquisition overall expansion in a high-stakes environment. 
Navigate the complexity of marketing automation tools to build transactional, promotional, and informational content that converts users. 
Scale campaigns across new countries, balancing the need for speed with the messiness of local market requirements. 
Unblock growth by developing learning agendas, moving from experimentation planning to global scaling. 
Collaborate cross-functionally with data science, product, and regional ops teams to identify consumer insights and influence strategy without direct authority. 
Own campaign performance end-to-end, reporting on KPIs and adjusting your approach based on shifting priorities and business needs. 


Basic Qualifications 


4+ years of experience in customer marketing, customer communications, or the customer engagement space. 
Experience with marketing automation tools and multi-channel campaign management (email, push, in-app). 
Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience. 


Preferred Qualifications 


Proven track record of delivering business results through A/B testing and experimentation at scale. 
Strong systems thinking approach with a fervent interest in how tech stacks empower CRM solutions. 
Ability to thrive in ambiguity and manage multiple stakeholders to remove structural roadblocks. 
Excellent project management skills with a rigorous attention to detail and swift execution. 


Ready to Ride?

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.

Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

title: Visual QA

Review specifications, brand guidelines, and design documents to anticipate potential quality risks.

About Rippling

Rippling is the first way for businesses to manage all of their HR & IT—payroll, benefits, computers, apps, and more—in one unified workforce platform.

By connecting every business system to one source of truth for employee data, businesses can automate all of the manual work they normally need to do to make employee changes. Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can just click a button and set up a new employees’ payroll, health insurance, work computer, and third-party apps—like Slack, Zoom, and Office 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

Job Title: Senior Software Engineer

Work Mode: 100% Remote

Employment Type: Contractor (hourly pay, no benefits; candidate responsible for own taxes)

About the Role

We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer to build and improve the backend services and internal tooling that power our business. You will work across squads, starting wherever you are most needed, and own meaningful slices of work end to end.

In this role, you will design, build, and ship production-ready services and internal web applications that help teams operate accurately and efficiently. You will partner closely with product, design, and engineering leadership, influence technical direction, and help shape the systems that keep our platform reliable, secure, and easy to extend.




Backend: Java/Kotlin + enterprise/backend development + microservices + event-driven/Kafka + Ruby preferred

Frontend: React + TypeScript/JavaScript + reusable components + responsive design




Responsibilities

Design, build, and ship backend services and internal tooling that support our teams and customers, owning medium-to-large features end to end so teammates can understand, operate, and extend what you ship.
Produce high-quality, performant, secure, and testable code that contributes to company-wide initiatives and handle data in accordance with company policy.
Develop across our stack, including JVM (Java, Kotlin), Elixir, Ruby, React, TypeScript, GraphQL, Kafka, AWS/Lambda, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, and related tooling.

Improve reliability and maintainability over time by using metrics and incidents to learn, strengthening observability, and leaving systems easier to run than you found them.




Requirements

4+ years of software engineering experience.
Experience building production-ready web applications and backend systems with reliability and security in mind.
Experience influencing technical direction, including architecture, standards, and delivery, rather than only executing predefined tasks.

Preferred Requirements

Production experience with JVM services (Java, Kotlin), including common frameworks and tooling, and/or web applications using JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and React.
Experience integrating LLMs or managed AI APIs into backend or internal tooling, such as enrichment, classification, attribution, or human-in-the-loop review.
Experience building microservices integrated with neighboring teams or shared platforms, including eCommerce or marketplace platforms.




Must-Have Technical Skills

Backend

4+ years of software engineering experience.
Strong Kotlin and/or Java experience.
Ruby experience preferred.
Strong understanding of enterprise applications.




Frontend

React experience in production environments.
Experience building reusable components.
Responsive design and cross-browser compatibility.
Understanding of frontend performance optimization.
Accessibility (A11Y) knowledge preferred.




Architecture

Microservices architecture.
Event-driven architecture.
System design and scalability.
Experience with complex enterprise systems.

description:
About the job

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced TRACK PMS Expert / Webmaster to take ownership of our company's use of TRACK PMS.

This is a highly specialized role for someone with hands-on, expert-level experience using and troubleshooting TRACK PMS. You will be responsible for managing system configurations, troubleshooting technical issues, monitoring integrations and synchronizations, and working directly with the TRACK provider when technical support is required.

The ideal candidate is highly technical, resourceful, and able to independently investigate problems, identify root causes, and drive issues through to resolution.

Key Responsibilities

Manage and maintain the company's day-to-day use of TRACK PMS
Troubleshoot TRACK-related technical and system issues
Investigate errors, system problems, and synchronization issues
Monitor and troubleshoot integrations between TRACK and other platforms
Review and manage TRACK settings, configurations, workflows, and processes
Identify root causes of technical and operational issues within TRACK
Work directly with TRACK's support and technical teams to resolve complex issues
Clearly document issues and provide relevant technical information to the TRACK provider
Follow up with the provider until issues are fully resolved
Support internal team members with TRACK-related questions and usage issues
Identify opportunities to improve workflows, configurations, and overall use of TRACK
Serve as the company's internal subject-matter expert and primary point of contact for TRACK PMS
Maintain documentation of recurring issues, solutions, configurations, and processes

Requirements

Expert-level, hands-on experience with TRACK PMS is required
Strong knowledge of TRACK PMS functionality, workflows, settings, and configurations
Proven experience troubleshooting TRACK-related technical issues
Experience troubleshooting integrations, data synchronization, and system errors
Ability to investigate issues independently and identify the underlying cause
Comfortable communicating directly with software providers and technical support teams
Strong technical troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
Excellent attention to detail and ability to manage issues through resolution
Ability to work independently and take full ownership of technical problems
Strong written and verbal communication skills

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in property management, vacation rentals, hospitality, or real estate
Experience working with other PMS platforms or property management technology
Experience managing software integrations and third-party systems
Experience documenting technical processes and troubleshooting procedures

Important Requirement

TRACK PMS experience is non-negotiable.

We are specifically looking for someone who has direct, hands-on experience with TRACK PMS and can confidently troubleshoot and manage the platform.

Experience with other PMS platforms alone — such as Guesty, Hostaway, Lodgify, Hostfully, or similar systems — will not be sufficient unless the candidate also has substantial TRACK PMS experience.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who can become the go-to TRACK expert within the company someone who doesn't simply escalate problems, but can investigate issues, understand how the system works, communicate effectively with the provider, and drive technical problems to resolution.

If you have extensive TRACK PMS experience and enjoy solving complex software and integration issues, we'd love to hear from you.

About the job

Job Details

Role: Performance Manager (Demand Gen)

Department: Performance

Job Location: Remote (Mexico)

Hours: Monday - Friday 9AM-5PM (in your timezone, flexible hours)

Total Compensation: $607,000 - $789,000 MXN + Benefits

New Hire Starting Pay: $607,000 - $744,000 MXN + Benefits

Role Availability: This posting is for an existing vacancy at Thrive Digital

As a company that values inclusion and diversity, Thrive seeks individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to apply for this position. We encourage anybody who is interested in this position to please apply!

About Thrive

Thrive is a leading full-funnel digital marketing agency supporting growth for some of North America’s most ambitious companies. We evolve our services through disciplined learning, continuous improvement, and close partnership with our clients - regularly assessing what works, what doesn’t, and where to raise the bar.

Our mission is to help companies grow sustainably. To do that, we’ve built deep expertise across performance marketing, brand marketing, digital design, and data and measurement, managing more than $5 billion USD in advertising spend over the past decade. Our work spans startups, scale-ups, and enterprise organizations, including Alo, Zoom, Slack, Uber, Asana, Masterclass, Snapchat, Change.org, and lululemon.

Our culture values curiosity, accountability, and thoughtful problem-solving. We challenge our teams to grow and take ownership of their work while respecting boundaries and long-term sustainability. Thrive is a place where experimentation is encouraged, learning is continuous, and people are supported to do high-quality work they’re proud of — together.

The Opportunity

This is a build-and-grow moment. We're expanding our performance practice around lead generation, and the work comes with a portfolio most marketers only get to admire from the outside — think category-defining B2B software and technology brands, the kind of companies whose products you already use and whose growth story is still being written. You won't just be running campaigns for them; you'll be the strategic partner helping them figure out how demand generation compounds into pipeline, market share, and durable growth. That means owning the questions that actually move a business: how do we reach the right buyers earlier, turn intent into qualified pipeline, and build a lead engine that scales as they do? The tactical craft matters — funnel design, lead quality, CPL and lead-to-opportunity performance — but here it's in service of something bigger: shaping how some of the most ambitious brands in tech grow. If your best work has been measured in ROAS, purchases, or app installs, this likely isn't your fit. But if you think about demand gen as a growth strategy, not just a channel, let's chat.

The Role

Joining the Performance department (performance marketing) as our Performance Manager, you'll be responsible for driving project excellence in Performance Programs by implementing growth strategies, solving complex problems, and fostering team development to ensure that Thrive remains an industry leader in performance marketing. You'll oversee the success of some of our highest priority brands and partnerships, ranging from household names through to brands that are in early growth stages. You'll also be a key contributor to product innovation and project growth initiatives, working amongst a collaborative team to continuously improve our product and service.

Your focus will of responsibilities will be:


Domain: Recognized as a leader in performance marketing at Thrive, you solve client challenges with innovative solutions, advocate for team member career growth, and contribute to agency-wide thought leadership in your area of expertise.
Example: You'll lead teams in the research, media planning and strategic roadmaps across some of our largest brands. You are responsible for mobilizing internal teams and working alongside them from inception through to hands-on, ongoing execution execution and optimization, while reporting to stakeholders on key performance indicators.


Client: Improve and redefine client success standards at Thrive by championing exceptional client service. Solve client and project issues with performance marketing solutions and provide advice on workflow and resource management.
Example: You lead strategic conversations with some of our largest clients 1:1, proactively engaging in and consistently monitoring client sentiment to ensure we’re addressing any challenges and opportunities. You provide constructive feedback to team members and work in partnership with the senior operational team to address any resourcing, performance or economic shifts.


People: Enhance the Performance department’s expertise by mentoring and managing team members, and contributing to their development through upskilling, training content, workshops, and other company resources.
Example: You either manage team members directly or work closely with them in a mentor and advocate capacity. Operating at a senior-manager level, you develop other leaders & address any role performance challenges proactively and appropriately. You set team members up for success to continuously elevate their roles on projects, are expert at giving feedback and approach difficult conversations with confidence and care.


Company: Make significant contributions to people and projects within the Performance department by solving complex problems, coordinating support, and aligning with stakeholders. Use performance marketing expertise to enhance organizational initiatives and support company goals.
Example: You lead company-level conversations and initiatives that keep us on the leading edge of performance marketing. You get buy-in, work through change management, and successfully collaborate with cross-functional support as needed.

We’re committed to delivering an exceptional onboarding experience that will create a strong foundation for your launch in this role:


In your first 30 days you’ll familiarize yourself with Thrive’s tools and processes and begin onboarding to projects and teams across your department, identifying performance opportunities and building relationships.
In your first 60 days you’ll be playing an active role across projects, collaborating with teams on day-to-day and longer-term account initiatives. You’ll begin developing processes and strategies to improve team and project success and sharing key insights with others.
In your first 90 days you’ll be stepping into account leadership opportunities, providing support across project planning, strategy, client partnerships and team skills development. You’ll begin collaborating with senior stakeholders across the company, leveraging your experience to provide valuable feedback and move initiatives forward. 


Qualifications


You've planned and executed multi-channel, full-funnel performance marketing campaigns with media spends exceeding $500k USD per month, delivering consistently positive ROI across multiple platforms (e.g., Meta, Search, YouTube, Programmatic, TikTok).
You’ve mobilized and led teams of 5-10, providing direct management, training, and strategic guidance to develop junior team members into management roles.
You’ve built and customized dashboards using tools like Google Sheets, Excel, Looker or Tableau to streamline reporting, analyze performance data, and focus on key business objectives and KPIs.
You’ve developed or improved internal initiatives or processes that have been adopted company-wide, elevating performance standards across the organization.
You’ve driven performance media strategy across diverse business verticals, having successfully led pacing, forecasting, and reporting with business objectives, and effectively communicated these strategies to senior stakeholders, including C-Suite executives.
You’ve successfully managed client relationships with multiple stakeholders, delivering strategic recommendations, resolving complex situations, and gaining buy-in through clear and effective communication across meetings and digital channels.


Equal Opportunity Employer

Thrive is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We have zero tolerance for bullying, discrimination, or harassment of any kind, and we strive to create an environment where everyone feels safe, supported, and valued.

This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, performance management, training, compensation, and advancement. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in any stage of the selection process.

Competitive Total Compensation Package

At Thrive, we offer a competitive total compensation package that reflects role scope, experience, and impact. This includes a comprehensive benefits program with remote-first, flexible work, paid vacation and wellbeing time, career development support, internal career coaches, and robust health, dental, and paramedical coverage, and so much more!

The Use of Artificial Intelligence

Every application, interview, and candidate interaction at Thrive is reviewed and managed by a human. Where AI tools are used to support parts of the hiring process, candidates are informed and asked to provide consent.

Hiring Eligibility by Location

While Thrive operates as a remote-first organization and hires globally, work authorization requirements vary by role and location. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where the role is based. For roles based in Canada, candidates must already be eligible to work in Canada. Thrive does not provide visa sponsorship.

Beware of Hiring Scams

Thrive Digital will never offer employment or request personal information outside of our official application process. While we do reach out to people on social channels, most commonly LinkedIn, with information about our active job posts, we always include a detailed recruitment package and a link to our careers page to apply. We do not reach out to candidates via text, WhatsApp or telegram or request any personal information. All recruiting communications will come from an @thrivedigital.com email address or our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse).

Thrive is a remote-first company with team members working across multiple regions. We recognize and respect the Indigenous histories of the lands where our team lives and works.

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

We are looking for a highly analytical and business-driven leader to join our Regional Pricing team and help shape the future of courier pricing strategy across the region. Identify and scale efficiency levers, translating learnings into clear pricing principles, methodologies and playbooks across markets.

We're eager to be in touch because you have...

High ownership, business judgment and ability to operate effectively in ambiguous and fast-changing environment.
Excellent communication and storytelling skills.
Advanced english level.

title: Coordinador/a de Postprodución
description:
About the job

Buscamos un/a Coordinador/a de Postproducción para supervisar y dar seguimiento integral a los procesos de postproducción de proyectos audiovisuales de CAPONETO CONTENT. 




El perfil ideal combina conocimientos técnicos con capacidad de organización, comunicación y resolución de problemas. Será el vínculo entre productores, editores, coloristas, artistas de VFX, diseñadores, estudios de sonido y proveedores externos, asegurando que cada proyecto avance en tiempo, presupuesto y conforme a sus especificaciones técnicas y creativas.




RESPONSABILIDADES:

•⁠ ⁠Diseñar, organizar y dar seguimiento a los flujos de trabajo de postproducción, desde la recepción y respaldo del material hasta la entrega final.

•⁠ ⁠Elaborar calendarios, rutas críticas y planes de entregas para proyectos simultáneos.

•⁠ ⁠Supervisar procesos de ingesta, respaldo, organización, sincronización, generación de proxies, edición offline, conformado, color, VFX, mezcla y masterización.

•⁠ ⁠Verificar formatos, códecs, resoluciones, frame rates, relaciones de aspecto, espacios de color y especificaciones de audio.

•⁠ ⁠Preparar y revisar masters, versiones, subtítulos, materiales gráficos y entregables para plataformas, networks, festivales, salas y redes sociales.

•⁠ ⁠Realizar controles de calidad técnicos y de contenido antes de cada entrega.

•⁠ ⁠Llevar un registro claro de versiones, cambios, aprobaciones y pendientes.

•⁠ ⁠Administrar materiales en servidores, discos, plataformas de revisión y sistemas de almacenamiento en la nube.

•⁠ ⁠Detectar riesgos técnicos, retrasos o cuellos de botella y proponer soluciones de manera anticipada.




CONOCIMIENTOS TÉCNICOS

•⁠ ⁠Dominio de formatos, códecs, contenedores, resoluciones y estándares de entrega audiovisual.

•⁠ ⁠Conocimiento práctico de flujos de edición offline y online, proxies, relink, conformado y masterización.

•⁠ ⁠Experiencia con procesos de corrección de color, VFX, motion graphics, mezcla de sonido y subtitulaje.

•⁠ ⁠Manejo de Adobe Premiere Pro y conocimiento de DaVinci Resolve y After Effects.

•⁠ ⁠Familiaridad con plataformas de revisión y colaboración como Frame.io o similares.

•⁠ ⁠Conocimiento de almacenamiento, respaldos, transferencia de archivos y organización de media.

•⁠ ⁠Capacidad para interpretar y aplicar especificaciones técnicas de plataformas, televisoras y distribuidores.

•⁠ ⁠Deseable: conocimiento de flujos de trabajo para cine, HDR, DCP, IMF y materiales de distribución internacional.




PERFIL

•⁠ ⁠Experiencia comprobable coordinando postproducción audiovisual.

•⁠ ⁠Español e inglés profesional, tanto oral como escrito.

•⁠ ⁠Extremadamente organizado/a y cuidadoso/a con los detalles.

•⁠ ⁠Perfil técnico, práctico y orientado a soluciones.

•⁠ ⁠Facilidad para manejar varios proyectos, proveedores y fechas de entrega simultáneamente.

•⁠ ⁠Excelentes habilidades interpersonales y de comunicación.

•⁠ ⁠Capacidad para traducir necesidades creativas en procesos y requerimientos técnicos claros.

description:
About the job

Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

The Pro Verifications team decides whether a business signing up on the Pro side is who it says it is, and whether we're allowed to onboard it. That means figuring out who actually owns the business, running it against sanctions and watchlists, and doing all of it fast enough that a real customer doesn't lose patience and leave. Every Pro customer hits these systems, so slow or wrong is very visible — and the team is early, which means whoever joins gets to decide how a lot of it works instead of inheriting it.

How We Work


We deploy constantly, almost always behind a flag, in pieces small enough to pull back fast.
Security and compliance show up at design time, not as a gate at the end.
Every story is tied to a metric it's meant to move — if work isn't on the board, it doesn't get staffed.
At this level, you're expected to shape these standards, not just work inside them.


The opportunity

As a Staff Engineer on Pro Verifications, you'll own the technical direction for how verification is built here — the architecture, the patterns other engineers work inside, and the calls about what we own versus what we lean on a vendor for. You'll be hands-on across the stack, drive out entire classes of recurring failure rather than patching them one at a time, and design the fail-closed and audit behavior that keeps regulators satisfied.

This is a high-impact, hands-on technical leadership role for engineers who've built where being wrong has real consequences, and who want to shape a system that stays fast, safe, and defensible as it grows.


Set the shape of the verification services and their contracts across the KYC/KYB flow.
Decide how we abstract KYC and KYB vendors so a bad provider day doesn't turn into an outage.
Design fail-closed behavior and audit trails that hold up under regulatory scrutiny.
Identify the classes of failure that keep recurring and remove them for good.
Write and drive architecture decisions (ADRs), and hold the line on security and compliance at design time, not as a late gate.
Mentor and raise the bar for senior engineers through design reviews, code, and direct feedback.
Be measured on whether verification gets faster, more of it decides itself, fewer decisions are wrong, and the systems stay up — and on whether the team got stronger for you being on it.


What You Bring


Around eight years building and running production systems, with a track record of owning a domain's technical direction, not just delivering inside one.
Deep, fluent expertise in Rust, with the versatility to work across TypeScript and React where verification meets the customer.
You've set architecture other people build on, and it held up — you can point to specific classes of failure you designed out, not just incidents you fixed.
You've made teams faster through patterns, tooling, or mentoring — engineers around you got better and shipped more because of calls you made.
You've built where being wrong had real consequences: compliance, payments, security, or anywhere a bad call costs more than a rough user experience.
Strong on distributed systems, service contracts, and secure design — you've integrated third-party APIs that couldn't be trusted, with real timeouts, retries, idempotency, circuit breakers, and backup paths that actually get tested.
Comfortable with, or able to quickly ramp on, gRPC, Temporal, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, MySQL/MariaDB, Redis, and GitLab CI.


Nice to haves


Direct experience with KYC, KYB, or fraud work, including integrating providers like Trulioo, Persona, or ComplyAdvantage.
Comfort building with AI in the loop.
Time spent in crypto, fintech, or another space regulators pay close attention to.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

Coordinate purchase-order expiration dates, price changes, store changes, and customer-specific order requirements with the appropriate owners.
Support new-customer, new-store, and new-channel onboarding and confirm operational readiness before the first transaction is processed.
Manage the operational follow-up required for Liverpool invoicing, MIGO confirmation, and counter-receipt completion.
Investigate missing goods receipts and discrepancies involving purchase orders, stores, quantities, pricing, delivery documents, invoice status, or customer portal information.
Coordinate document recovery, invoice correction, and re-billing activities with Accounts Receivable, Commercial, Logistics, and the customer as applicable.
Maintain visibility of open items, aging, financial exposure, actions, and owners until final closure.
Monitor billing blocks, e-invoicing exceptions, rejected invoices, missing billing documents, and order-to-invoice discrepancies.
Troubleshoot operational billing issues and support approved invoice corrections or re-billing activities.
Provide supporting operational documentation to Accounts Receivable/Credit for invoice disputes, deductions, collection follow-up, and customer inquiries.

Support order-to-cash execution without assuming ownership of credit approval, collections strategy, cash application, or final credit-note approval.
Create and manage consignment orders, consignment returns, billing follow-up, and related inventory or customer discrepancies.
Create and follow up on return authorizations and RMAs after validating customer, invoice, product, quantity, reason, and approval information.
Coordinate physical return collection with Logistics and receipt, inspection, disposition, and inventory processing with Warehouse Operations and the 3PL.
Track returns from authorization through warehouse receipt, quality inspection, credit-note initiation, and closure, including aging, missing, damaged, or unauthorized returns.
Coordinate RMA closure and reporting with Accounts Receivable, Finance, Warehouse Operations, and the customer.
Validate customer, ship-to, store, delivery, billing, EDI, and portal setup from an operational perspective before transactions begin.
Identify customer-master or product-master issues that prevent correct order processing and submit changes through the approved MDM process.
Confirm that approved customer, store, pricing, or product changes have been correctly implemented before order release.
Maintain segregation between requesting, approving, and executing master-data or sensitive transaction changes.
Monitor and troubleshoot SAP sales orders, EDI transactions, inventory-availability messages, SAP/WMS order-status interfaces, e-invoicing, customer portals, and pricing conditions.
Determine whether an issue originates from customer information, master data, pricing, SAP configuration, EDI mapping, WMS/3PL execution, inventory, or user error.
Document system issues with transaction numbers, evidence, expected results, and business impact, and coordinate resolution with IT/SAP, Master Data, Global Customer Operations, or the 3PL.
Own issue follow-up through correction, business validation, and final closure rather than only forwarding the initial request.
Support inventory-interface troubleshooting and controlled manual contingencies only when the required approvals, duplicate-order controls, reconciliation, and audit trail are in place.

Prepare and maintain daily, weekly, and monthly reporting for order volume, manual versus EDI orders, EDI failures, open and blocked orders, order aging, billing exceptions, Liverpool MIGO and counter-receipt status, missing PODs, returns/RMA, and system issues.
Quantify the sales, customer-service, billing, collection, or inventory impact of material exceptions and communicate the required action clearly.
Maintain issue trackers and action logs with owners, due dates, escalation triggers, and closure evidence.
Identify recurring errors, bottlenecks, and manual activities and recommend process, system, automation, or control improvements.
Support operational reviews with Support operational reviews with Customer Operations, Commercial, Finance, IT/SAP, Logistics, Warehouse Operations, and external partners

2-4 years of experience in Customer Operations, Order Management, Customer Service, Sales Operations, Supply Chain, or an order-to-cash environment.
Experience processing B2B customer orders and managing order, billing, or return exceptions.
Working knowledge of SAP, preferably SAP SD and order-to-cash processes, together with EDI, customer portals, e-invoicing, or integrated order-management environments.
Experience supporting department stores, wholesale customers, e-commerce, or marketplace channels strongly preferred.
Knowledge of Mexican retail billing, counter-receipt, POD, return, and customer-documentation requirements; Liverpool process experience is highly desirable.
Intermediate to advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including data validation, pivot tables, lookups, and operational reporting.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, follow-up, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in Spanish and working proficiency in English for collaboration with regional and global stakeholders.
Experience in a multi-brand, high-value product, fashion, watch, jewelry, luxury, or consumer-goods environment preferred.

title: Senior CRM Specialist - Recovery
skills: Analyze business data to make relevant decisions and build a coherent communication strategy: the right user, the precise message, the opportune moment; to shape behavior and get the pending loan paid.

Bring ambition for the metrics and a 360° business lens. Be able to run a cost-benefit analysis on every notch of the communication strategy you propose (contact cost, channel cost, fatigue cost, risk of the message, expected recovery).
Own the analytical read of what is working and what is not, and kill what is not.

Design and implement the communication strategy from end to end: lifecycle experience design in Figma, copy development, execution in CRM, execution of contact methods outside the CRM (e.g. WhatsApp through the Meta API), communication through the landing page, customer support channels, AI agents, and any other channel that emerges.
Build the channel logic for collections and defend it with results.
Produce the communications for every product development coming out of the squad.
Measure, with structure and clarity, the impact of the communication strategy on the business: default rate, loss rate, and recovery rate.

Keep measurement discipline as the default. Every initiative starts with a dashboard, a metric baseline, an expected uplift calculation, a landed definition of success, and guardrails. No initiative launches without them.
Own the full rollout. Every initiative includes execution and follow-through: correct full rollout, plus attention to any incident or edge case that appears along the way.

Answer "how do we stop this from happening again?" When an error or an edge case appears, the corresponding guardrails get incorporated into the AS IS — and we find out about problems as early as possible, so we get ahead of them instead of reacting to them.

Build the relationships before you need them. Lifecycle management does not work as a series of one-off requests: it depends on standing, close working relationships with Product, Engineering, CX and Data: with agreed SLAs for the things that recur (event instrumentation, data availability, review turnaround, incident response). Part of this role is establishing those agreements and keeping them healthy, so that the next initiative starts from an existing partnership instead of from a negotiation.

Operate as a business unit inside the squad. Work day to day with the product designers, front-end and back-end engineers and data scientists on your team; not as the communication person who receives a finished feature, but as one of the people accountable for the outcome. Every decision has more than one angle (product, risk, data, cost, customer experience), and you are expected to hold all of them.

Make sure every team tells the customer the same story. Align with Customer Support so the message is consistent across every touchpoint. Inconsistency in a collections context costs trust we do not get back.

Bring proposals, not tickets. Communication definitions arrive from this role as proposals to co-create with the squad, not as requests waiting for someone else to fill them. You come with a point of view backed by behavioral evidence, and you change it when the data disagrees.
Desired 5+ years in CRM, lifecycle communications or retention marketing; ideally in fintech, financial services, lending or high-growth B2C.
Proven experience owning communication programs that moved a hard business metric, not only engagement metrics.

HubSpot, Zoho

description:
About the job

The mission:

We are looking for someone who will produce a significant uplift in Baubap's collections metrics through lifecycle management.

Recovery here starts earlier than most people expect. It begins at the customer's very first disbursed loan - when they still pay on time - and it ends with a dormant or churned customer who left without paying. Everything in between (the reminder, the due date, the first day late, the negotiation, the recovery of an old balance) is one continuous experience, and this role owns the communication layer across all of it.

The person in this role makes that experience cohesive: communication that mirrors the product experience. They use behavioral psychology and channel logic to shape the customer's payment decision, and to pull that decision as early as possible.

This is not a "send the campaign" role. It is the role that decides who we talk to, with what message, through which channel, at what moment, and then proves, with data, what that decision was worth to the business.

The expected outcome:

Business analysis and communication strategy


Analyze business data to make relevant decisions and build a coherent communication strategy: the right user, the precise message, the opportune moment; to shape behavior and get the pending loan paid.
Bring ambition for the metrics and a 360° business lens. Be able to run a cost-benefit analysis on every notch of the communication strategy you propose (contact cost, channel cost, fatigue cost, risk of the message, expected recovery).
Own the analytical read of what is working and what is not, and kill what is not.


End-to-end design and execution


Design and implement the communication strategy from end to end: lifecycle experience design in Figma, copy development, execution in CRM, execution of contact methods outside the CRM (e.g. WhatsApp through the Meta API), communication through the landing page, customer support channels, AI agents, and any other channel that emerges.
Build the channel logic for collections and defend it with results.
Produce the communications for every product development coming out of the squad.


Measurement, rollout, and guardrails


Measure, with structure and clarity, the impact of the communication strategy on the business: default rate, loss rate, and recovery rate.
Keep measurement discipline as the default. Every initiative starts with a dashboard, a metric baseline, an expected uplift calculation, a landed definition of success, and guardrails. No initiative launches without them.
Own the full rollout. Every initiative includes execution and follow-through: correct full rollout, plus attention to any incident or edge case that appears along the way.
Answer "how do we stop this from happening again?" When an error or an edge case appears, the corresponding guardrails get incorporated into the AS IS — and we find out about problems as early as possible, so we get ahead of them instead of reacting to them.


Cross-functional work


Build the relationships before you need them. Work day to day with the product designers, front-end and back-end engineers and data scientists on your team; not as the communication person who receives a finished feature, but as one of the people accountable for the outcome. Every decision has more than one angle (product, risk, data, cost, customer experience), and you are expected to hold all of them.
Make sure every team tells the customer the same story. Align with Customer Support so the message is consistent across every touchpoint. Inconsistency in a collections context costs trust we do not get back.

Develop and implement the B2B marketing strategy with primary focus on Mexico, aligned with business objectives and regional direction, with the ability to extend initiatives, learnings, and impact to Colombia and the rest of Latin America.

The Analyst II plays a key role in delivering an exceptional seller experience by ensuring commission calculations are accurate, issues are resolved promptly, and compensation processes support Rackspace's Go-to-Market strategy.

Key Responsibilities

Sales Compensation Administration


 Administer assigned sales compensation plans in accordance with approved plan documents and policies.
 Calculate, validate, and process monthly and quarterly commission payments.
 Review commission calculations for completeness and accuracy prior to payroll submission.
 Investigate and resolve commission discrepancies, exceptions, and inquiries from sales employees and managers.
 Support commission adjustments, true-ups, recoveries, and manual calculations when required.


Incentive Compensation Systems


 Maintain employee, territory, quota, crediting, and compensation data within the Incentive Compensation Management platform (Captivate IQ).
 Assist with data validation, system testing, and periodic system updates.
 Identify data quality issues and partner with Sales Operations and HR to resolve discrepancies.
 Support system enhancements and process improvement initiatives.


Reporting & Analytics


 Prepare recurring commission reports and dashboards for Sales, Finance, and Total Rewards leadership.
 Assist with commission forecasting, accrual support, and financial reporting.
 Analyze commission trends and identify unusual payment activity requiring further review.
 Support audit requests and maintain documentation supporting commission calculations.


Cross-Functional Partnership


 Partner with Sales Operations to ensure accurate opportunity crediting and sales hierarchy alignment.
 Collaborate with Payroll to ensure timely commission payments.
 Support Finance with monthly accruals and reconciliation activities.
 Work with HR and Sales leadership to explain commission plans and resolve participant questions.


Governance & Compliance


 Maintain accurate documentation supporting commission calculations and plan administration.
 Ensure administration activities comply with company policies and approved compensation plans.
 Participate in internal and external audit requests as needed.
 Recommend improvements to increase efficiency, accuracy, and internal controls.


Qualifications


 Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Human Resources, Mathematics, or a related field.
 Approximately 2–5 years of experience in sales compensation, payroll, finance, sales operations, or compensation administration.
 Experience working with incentive compensation management systems (such as SAP Callidus, Captivate IQ, or similar) preferred.
 Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including PivotTables, XLOOKUP/INDEX-MATCH, and data analysis.
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail.
 Ability to interpret compensation plans and perform complex calculations accurately.
 Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
 Experience working in a global or multinational organization is preferred.
 English proficiency required.

We are the multicloud solutions experts. We combine our expertise with the world’s leading technologies — across applications, data and security — to deliver end-to-end solutions. We have a proven record of advising customers based on their business challenges, designing solutions that scale, building and managing those solutions, and optimizing returns into the future. Named a best place to work, year after year according to Fortune, Forbes and Glassdoor, we attract and develop world-class talent. Though we’re all different, Rackers thrive through our connection to a central goal: to be a valued member of a winning team on an inspiring mission. We bring our whole selves to work every day. Your work will help reduce operational risk, improve automation performance, and enable teams to solve higher-value business problems with greater efficiency and reliability.

Strong collaboration and communication skills, with experience working across technical and business teams to clarify requirements, evaluate tradeoffs, and guide complex initiatives

Experience building production agentic AI systems using frameworks such as LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, or equivalent, including context management, tool calling, reliability, and cost considerations
